clarification.gate_evidence: missing, null, malformed, or uninterpretable required gate evidence blocks validation and never defaults to pass
clarification.group_eligibility: a ticker/date/horizon/entry/exit group is eligible only when every canonical observation has abstained=false, risk_rejected=false, and rule_rejected=false; any explicit rejection makes the entire group ineligible
clarification.group_score: arithmetic mean of saved finite scores over every canonical observation in the group; passing members are never subsetted
clarification.multiplicity_weighting: observation multiplicity does not increase a ticker group's cohort weight
clarification.rejected_evidence: rejected groups and member-level gate reasons remain in audit evidence

historical_scope: clarification of the new cohort-relative experiment only; historical v1.1 specification and results are unchanged
